News discussed in this episode:

  • Reports say M7 Ultra may come with up to 1.5TB of memory, finally catching up with the 2019 Mac Pro
  • Apple is developing a next-generation Apple Pencil, expected to launch next year, possibly adopting a replaceable battery design
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max component costs may increase by nearly US$300
  • Apple lawsuit has no impact on OpenAI hardware launch timeline
